resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1932 and the Forest Lookouts page says the tower was erected in 1933. The sources do not settle it; the story gives both years.
The register says 70 feet (21.3 m); Forest Lookouts says approximately 73 feet. Facts use the register's figure.
Forest Lookouts names the Wisconsin Department of Conservation; the register names the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources. The story uses the register's name.
The register lists the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources as administrator and a visit note says the tower is on private property. No source explains how both hold.

notes_for_editor: Built year and height disagree between the register (1932, 70 ft) and Forest Lookouts (1933, approximately 73 ft). The 1950s cab fire has no exact year in any source, so its burned and rebuilt events carry no year. Access is recorded as private from one 2018 visit note; no current access policy was found. Clark County runs a Bruce Mound recreation site, but no source ties it to the tower. A Clark County history page on the 1948-2013 recreation area was read but not cited, since it does not mention the tower. The register's photo credit (Brian Ziegler) has no image URL I could find, so no photos added.
